acceptance.next: No remaining experiment work;no model or operator reruns;large scientific payloads remain remote

model_summary.aggregation: Equal weight per route;G means use frozen comparison weights within each route

definitions.Gplus: Comparison-weighted mean, original frozen Writer centers, reference positive matrix averaged after positive-part extraction over D=0..2047
definitions.reader_score: Correct-successor native attention with route minus after direct key-route removal in that same condition; equal query weight, reported in percentage points
definitions.intervention: Actual Reader Q and Writer V weights and biases; one fixed mean-preserving orthogonal map per route; full C conjugation at all distances
limits: Hminus and A directions also rotate

Optimization uses all frozen center comparisons; not held-out token generalization
Reference Gplus minimum does not certify every pair or every distance near zero
